== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|An Underlady is a female practitioner who has attained the rank of [[Underlord]], a significant stage of power within the spiritual hierarchy. This rank allows individuals to assume humanoid forms and grants them enhanced physical capabilities, such as the ability to withstand minor burns or function with minimal sleep. While [[Underlord|Underlords]] are expected to assist in imperial defense during emergencies, they typically require specific information or family representation to secure audiences with the Emperor. The progression from [[Underlord]] to [[Archlady]] represents a vast increase in power and spiritual stability. Various individuals hold this title, including members of major families like the [[Akura clan|Akura]] and Arelius family{{!}}Arelius clans. These practitioners utilize diverse combat techniques, ranging from Shadow{{!}}shadow-based paths and [[sword]] mastery to the manipulation of lightning or liquid [[dragon]]-fire. Some Underladies command retainers, such as [[Truegold|Truegolds]], and utilize specialized tools like clouds of condensed [[aura]] for flight. The rank is associated with significant spiritual milestones, such as achieving an [[Underlord revelation]], which can fundamentally shape a practitioner's path and purpose.}}

== Ghostwater ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-05-ghostwater|Clad in a sparkling [[sacred artist's robe]] of red, gold, and purple, the Underlady possesses golden eyes with vertical slits, patches of gold [[scales]] on her cheeks, and a thin, gold-scaled tail. During combat, she wields a [[sword]] that crackles with orange lightning. She launches an attack against [[Yerin]] using a rush of liquid flame, but her assault is interrupted when her own retainers tackle her.}}

== Underlord ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-06-underlord|An Underlady represents a specific stage of [[advancement]] that requires an individual to face their own truth. One such entity manifested as a woman with long, burning hair who carved a path through the forest by fire. Another Underlady was observed possessing gray skin and silver hair held by a purple ribbon. During the events at [[Lindon]]'s feet, an Underlady was seen undergoing a process of regeneration.}}

<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-06-underlord|The [[Underlady]] is a woman with long, burning hair who burns her way through the forest.<ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c11">''Underlord'', chapter 11</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-06-underlord|The process of becoming an [[Underlady]] involves facing the truth of oneself.<ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c13">''Underlord'', chapter 13</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-06-underlord|[[Underlady]] is a stage of [[advancement]].<ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c15">''Underlord'', chapter 15</ref>}}</li>
